Tensor path is unused (0%), and despite full reported warp activity, achieved SOL indicates substantial headroom (45.5%), pointing to efficiency/tiling/pipeline limits rather than a hard hardware roof.

root_causes.cause: Non-tensor-core matmul path limits arithmetic throughput on MI300X.

evidence.interpretation: No matrix/tensor instructions are active, so MFMA/tensor hardware is not being exploited.

fixes.fix: Use Triton configs and dtypes that lower to AMD MFMA/tensor instructions (e.g., FP16/BF16-focused matmul kernel path, verify generated ISA includes MFMA) and retune BLOCK_* accordingly.
fixes.rationale: Enabling matrix engines typically raises compute utilization significantly for GEMM, moving the kernel closer to compute roof.
